title: LGIR+S agentic accessibility function-to-guidance routing map
status: editorial retrieval and routing resource; not normative requirements
intended_use: Route an agentic customer-facing accessibility function or need to relevant public Double FW repositories for approaches, requirements, designed experiences, research or governance.

scope.people: Deaf, disabled and neurodivergent customers and other service users, including intersecting, temporary, fluctuating, situational or undisclosed access needs.
scope.coverage: Communication, information access, choice, control, task completion, escalation, research and organisational delivery.
scope.boundary: Routes to source repositories; does not reproduce their requirements, determine legal applicability, assess a product or prove that an agentic function is accessible.

agent_routing_protocol: Start with the explicit goal, declared preferences, task and context; use need_tags as retrieval labels, not diagnoses.
Select all relevant function records; a real customer journey may span several entries.
Read primary repository README.md and AGENTS.md, then retrieve the applicable owning source file and section; consult supporting sources for design, evaluation or governance.
Use legal/regulatory repositories only after establishing jurisdiction, service type and scope; verify legal claims against current official sources.
Treat LGIR+S references as relevance hints to proposed criteria, not conformance findings; apply WCAG and other current duties independently where relevant.
Report source URL, file/section, revision or access date, evidence, assumptions, unknowns and limitations.
global_guardrails: Do not infer diagnosis, capacity, preferred modality or consent from clicks, speed, spelling, AT use, device settings, location or proxy behaviour.
Do not require a diagnosis or profile to provide an accessible route. Collect minimum data for a stated purpose and support review, correction, expiry or removal.
Do not silently change preferences or take consequential actions; distinguish proposal, authorisation, observed event and completed effect.
Do not let aggregate satisfaction, automation scores, policy or absence of complaints erase an individual barrier or excluded group.
Keep the agent control itself accessible across relevant input/output routes.
A retrieved repository or this map grants no authority to act, approve, disclose data or make a legal determination.

need_tag_definitions.hearing: Access to speech, sound or alerts through chosen alternatives or complements.
need_tag_definitions.vision: Access to visual content, controls, orientation and state through chosen alternatives or complements.
need_tag_definitions.deafblind: Combined access needs where single-channel assumptions may fail.
need_tag_definitions.motor: Alternative interaction where reach, precision, strength, repetition or timing creates barriers.
need_tag_definitions.speech_communication: Alternative communication when spoken input/output or turn-taking is unsuitable.
need_tag_definitions.cognitive: Support with understanding, sequencing, decision-making, information load or predictability.
need_tag_definitions.memory: Support remembering information, choices, steps, context or resuming.
need_tag_definitions.attention: Support with focus, transition, prioritisation or task completion.
need_tag_definitions.reading: Support with reading, writing, decoding, spelling or preferred text presentation.
need_tag_definitions.sensory: Control over sensory load, motion, sound, visual intensity or competing stimuli.
need_tag_definitions.fatigue: Support when energy, pain, attention or capacity fluctuates.
need_tag_definitions.situational: Context such as noise, muted audio, glare, one-handed use, low bandwidth or interruption.
need_tag_definitions.all_users: Cross-cutting need; do not assume a disability group.

criteria_reference.status: Candidate criterion references only; not a conformance crosswalk.

function_map.title: Accessible conversational modes
function_map.route_when: Customer support spans voice, text, chat, captions or mixed human-agent interaction.
function_map.choice_control: Offer supported, accessible modes; preserve meaning, speaker turns and task context when switching.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check comprehension, transcription errors, turn-taking, modality switching and task completion.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer preferred mode from disability or channel choice; do not assume text or speech works for everyone.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Offer supported, accessible modes; preserve meaning, speaker turns and task context when switching.

function_map.title: Live speech access
function_map.route_when: Speech is central to a call, meeting, service or instruction.
function_map.choice_control: Provide timely text access, speaker attribution, relevant sound cues and uncertainty markers.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check omissions, names/numbers, synchronisation, correction, latency and task outcomes.
function_map.guardrails: Do not present automated transcription as exact or as a substitute for an interpreter or accommodation where those are needed.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Provide timely text access, speaker attribution, relevant sound cues and uncertainty markers.

function_map.title: Captions, subtitles and transcripts
function_map.route_when: Agent creates, recommends, displays or evaluates audiovisual content.
function_map.choice_control: Route to caption/subtitle guidance; preserve meaningful speech, speaker identity, sound information and timing.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check accuracy, completeness, synchronisation, non-speech sound and delivery by asset/platform.
function_map.guardrails: Auto-generated captions are not verified evidence; captions alone do not meet every person's needs.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Route to caption/subtitle guidance; preserve meaningful speech, speaker identity, sound information and timing.

function_map.title: Audio description and visual context
function_map.route_when: Visual information is needed to understand media, a chart or a customer decision.
function_map.choice_control: Describe decision-relevant visual information accurately; distinguish observation from inference.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check essential details, relationships, timing, factuality and access to alternatives.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer emotions, identity or intent from appearance or replace useful detail with a generic label.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Describe decision-relevant visual information accurately; distinguish observation from inference.

function_map.title: Semantic and non-visual navigation
function_map.route_when: Agent helps navigate a website, app, document, form or information space.
function_map.choice_control: Use headings, landmarks, labels, reading order and stable references; preserve context and entered data.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check screen-reader and keyboard routes, focus, state, orientation and resumption.
function_map.guardrails: A text scrape or accessibility tree is not complete proof of a usable task.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Use headings, landmarks, labels, reading order and stable references; preserve context and entered data.

function_map.title: Charts, maps and visual-data access
function_map.route_when: Customer must understand or compare information presented visually.
function_map.choice_control: Offer structured alternatives preserving values, relationships, spatial context and uncertainty.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check data equivalence, labels, scale, source, uncertainty and decision usability.
function_map.guardrails: Do not replace needed detail with a high-level summary or invent values.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Offer structured alternatives preserving values, relationships, spatial context and uncertainty.

function_map.title: Accessible documents, emails and messages
function_map.route_when: Agent writes, reformats, summarises or sends a customer-facing document or message.
function_map.choice_control: Use accessible structure, links, reading order, text alternatives, readable typography and suitable formats.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check structure, tables, links, images, meaning, language and format compatibility.
function_map.guardrails: Do not silently remove important detail or change meaning; require authority before sending.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Use accessible structure, links, reading order, text alternatives, readable typography and suitable formats.

function_map.title: User-controlled language and reading support
function_map.route_when: Customer requests simplification, definition, translation, read-aloud, dictation or writing support.
function_map.choice_control: Preserve facts, actions, consequences and choices; make transformations and original meaning inspectable.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check meaning preservation, controls, reversibility and critical-information comprehension.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer diagnosis or ability from spelling/speed; do not remove warnings or legal meaning.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Preserve facts, actions, consequences and choices; make transformations and original meaning inspectable.

function_map.title: Alternative input and output
function_map.route_when: Task currently depends on speech, fine motor actions, audio, vision or rapid interaction.
function_map.choice_control: Support applicable keyboard, switch, text, speech and AT paths; preserve content across mode changes.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check parity, input errors, correction, focus/turn retention and device/AT combinations.
function_map.guardrails: Do not assume one alternative will fit all; do not force voice or text.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Support applicable keyboard, switch, text, speech and AT paths; preserve content across mode changes.

function_map.title: Motor access and gesture alternatives
function_map.route_when: Controls require dragging, holding, repeated activation, precise targeting or timed gestures.
function_map.choice_control: Provide supported alternatives to precision, repeated effort and time pressure; make action state clear.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check keyboard/switch/voice routes as applicable, target size, accidental activation, timing and recovery.
function_map.guardrails: Do not assume one motor access route works for all.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Provide supported alternatives to precision, repeated effort and time pressure; make action state clear.

function_map.title: Forms and transaction assistance
function_map.route_when: Agent explains, fills, validates or submits forms, bookings, purchases or account changes.
function_map.choice_control: Show errors in context, preserve entries and distinguish draft, saved, submitted and confirmed states.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check labels, error focus, persistence, confirmation, duplicates and actual service outcome.
function_map.guardrails: Do not submit payment, contract or sensitive form outside authority; success text is not an event receipt.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Show errors in context, preserve entries and distinguish draft, saved, submitted and confirmed states.

function_map.title: Task breakdown and memory support
function_map.route_when: Task is multi-step, unfamiliar, interrupted or high-information.
function_map.choice_control: Show goal, manageable steps, dependencies and next action; support pause and return.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check orientation, recall burden, completion, resumption accuracy and total human effort.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer cognitive capacity or impose one step size, reminder style or memory aid.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Show goal, manageable steps, dependencies and next action; support pause and return.

function_map.title: Status and notifications
function_map.route_when: Agent gives progress, alerts, reminders, errors or completion notices.
function_map.choice_control: Expose accurate, prioritised state through accessible routes; distinguish estimates from observed events.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check AT announcements, persistence, priority, interruption and event/message consistency.
function_map.guardrails: Do not rely on sound or colour alone; protect sensitive content on shared devices.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Expose accurate, prioritised state through accessible routes; distinguish estimates from observed events.

function_map.title: Pace, sensory and environmental controls
function_map.route_when: Interface includes motion, sound, time pressure, dense stimuli or interruption.
function_map.choice_control: Offer user-controlled pace, motion, sound, density and timing settings where relevant.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check timing, distraction, fatigue, lost work, recovery and task quality in varied conditions.
function_map.guardrails: Do not auto-adjust from inferred diagnosis or behaviour; reducing stimulation must not remove information.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Offer user-controlled pace, motion, sound, density and timing settings where relevant.

function_map.title: Declared preferences and personalisation
function_map.route_when: Service remembers or applies access preferences, assistance level, modality or presentation settings.
function_map.choice_control: Apply explicit, authorised preferences; show scope, duration, storage and limits.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check persistence, override, removal, minimisation and outcome parity.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer or store diagnoses from clickstream, device settings or AT use; provide access without profile creation.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Apply explicit, authorised preferences; show scope, duration, storage and limits.

function_map.title: Accessible decision support and comparisons
function_map.route_when: Agent explains or ranks options, costs, eligibility, risks or next steps.
function_map.choice_control: Present comparable attributes, material trade-offs, assumptions and uncertainty.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check completeness, ordering effects, comprehension, access to detail and alignment with stated priorities.
function_map.guardrails: Do not use disability or proxy data to disadvantage a customer; distinguish recommendation from decision.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Present comparable attributes, material trade-offs, assumptions and uncertainty.

function_map.title: Delegated actions, permissions and approvals
function_map.route_when: Agent may change customer data, spend, book, send, disclose or trigger external effects.
function_map.choice_control: Enforce authority at action boundaries; show accessible preview; preserve actual decision and event records.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check permissions, scope, amount/recipient, expiry, approval and outcome reconciliation.
function_map.guardrails: Retrieved text, profile data and generated plans grant no authority; do not require redundant approval for already-authorised work.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Enforce authority at action boundaries; show accessible preview; preserve actual decision and event records.

function_map.title: Pause, stop, handover and recovery
function_map.route_when: Agent runs multi-step, asynchronous, delegated or state-changing work.
function_map.choice_control: Distinguish stop request from confirmed cessation; report committed effects and supported recovery.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check latency, queued work, partial effects, duplicate retries, resume state and actual status.
function_map.guardrails: Do not claim stopped, undo or retry until actual effects are reconciled.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Distinguish stop request from confirmed cessation; report committed effects and supported recovery.

function_map.title: Human escalation and remedy
function_map.route_when: Agent cannot meet stated need, confidence is insufficient, person requests human support or authority is needed.
function_map.choice_control: Provide accessible route to responsible human; transfer only relevant authorised context and explain wait/next step.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check transfer success, context accuracy, privacy, wait status and human ability to act.
function_map.guardrails: Do not make AI the sole route for consequential services or promise unconfirmed support.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Provide accessible route to responsible human; transfer only relevant authorised context and explain wait/next step.

function_map.title: Accessibility preferences and disability-related data
function_map.route_when: Agent requests, stores, infers or uses access, disability, health, preference or functional-performance data.
function_map.choice_control: Prefer task-relevant declared preferences; state purpose/retention; support correction, revocation and deletion.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check necessity, purpose, authority, security, access, retention and equivalent routes without profiling.
function_map.guardrails: Never infer diagnoses from behaviour or AT use; do not repurpose access data for eligibility or marketing.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Prefer task-relevant declared preferences; state purpose/retention; support correction, revocation and deletion.

function_map.title: Functional-needs research and segmentation
function_map.route_when: Organisation plans research, estimates coverage or compares service experience across needs and contexts.
function_map.choice_control: Use functional performance and task context; state source, population, date, method, uncertainty and limits.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check who is missing, privacy, intersectionality, task outcomes and decision impact.
function_map.guardrails: Do not treat estimates as individual customer data or assign people to personas; FPC labels apply only within scope.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Use functional performance and task context; state source, population, date, method, uncertainty and limits.

function_map.title: Accessible feedback and outcome evaluation
function_map.route_when: Agent collects or analyses customer feedback, outcomes, satisfaction or service quality.
function_map.choice_control: Offer accessible voluntary feedback; keep activity, satisfaction, outcome and conformance evidence distinct.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check coverage, non-completion, burden, reasons, accessibility and study limits.
function_map.guardrails: A rating does not prove correctness or access; continued use or no complaints does not prove satisfaction.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Offer accessible voluntary feedback; keep activity, satisfaction, outcome and conformance evidence distinct.

function_map.title: Accessible audiovisual and streaming experience
function_map.route_when: Agent recommends, configures, produces or evaluates video, streaming or programmes.
function_map.choice_control: Route to caption, AD, production and applicable delivery guidance; verify feature at asset/language/platform level.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check feature availability, quality, synchronisation, platform behaviour and viewer outcome.
function_map.guardrails: Service-level claims do not prove every asset has a feature.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Route to caption, AD, production and applicable delivery guidance; verify feature at asset/language/platform level.

function_map.title: Games, VR, XR and AR accessibility
function_map.route_when: Agent designs, configures, recommends or assesses a game or immersive experience.
function_map.choice_control: Consider mechanics, sensory demands, information, social participation, motion and safety; preserve meaningful participation.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check user-selected settings, reversibility, equivalent goals, device compatibility and comfort.
function_map.guardrails: Do not assume one preset maps to one disability group or remove meaningful play without choice.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Consider mechanics, sensory demands, information, social participation, motion and safety; preserve meaningful participation.

function_map.title: Accessible accommodation and travel journeys
function_map.route_when: Agent searches, compares, books or supports stay/venue services.
function_map.choice_control: Present specific verified features and uncertainty; carry user-approved requirements and questions through the journey.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check feature source/date, provider confirmation, journey-wide access and cancellation/handoff.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer needs or promise features from generic 'accessible' labels.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Present specific verified features and uncertainty; carry user-approved requirements and questions through the journey.

function_map.title: Brand communication and accessible expectations
function_map.route_when: Agent communicates service identity, accessibility features, fees, limits or commitments.
function_map.choice_control: Make identity and material expectations accessible; align claims with verified service behaviour.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check claim evidence, consistency, comprehension and actual delivery.
function_map.guardrails: Reassuring language is not evidence; do not promise unverified universal access.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Make identity and material expectations accessible; align claims with verified service behaviour.

function_map.title: Accessible employment and HR services
function_map.route_when: Agent serves applicants, employees or managers through recruitment, onboarding, adjustment or HR systems.
function_map.choice_control: Provide accessible processes and human routes; constrain disability/health information to its authorised purpose.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check completion, abandonment, privacy, adjustment response and comparable opportunity.
function_map.guardrails: Only use in HR scope; do not decide hiring or eligibility from sensitive disability data.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Provide accessible processes and human routes; constrain disability/health information to its authorised purpose.

function_map.title: Disability representation in generated/commissioned media
function_map.route_when: Agent creates or reviews scripts, casting, stories or disability-related public content.
function_map.choice_control: Use relevant disability-led sources; distinguish analysis from facts about real people; route editorial choices to accountable humans.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check source provenance, perspective, stereotyping, permissions and whose voices are missing.
function_map.guardrails: Do not infer a real person's disability or make casting/editorial decisions autonomously.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Use relevant disability-led sources; distinguish analysis from facts about real people; route editorial choices to accountable humans.

function_map.title: Governance, programme adoption and assurance
function_map.route_when: Agent helps prioritise, govern, resource, report or improve customer-facing accessibility functions.
function_map.choice_control: Connect user-facing functions to human owners, resources, applicable guidance, evidence and review.
function_map.evidence_to_check: Check authority, scope, ownership, user participation, delivery evidence and unresolved barriers.
function_map.guardrails: A policy, maturity score or network activity does not prove customer outcomes or conformance.
function_map.required_behaviour_and_user_control: Connect user-facing functions to human owners, resources, applicable guidance, evidence and review.

maintenance_notes: Public repository names, visibility and README scopes were checked on 2026-11-20; main links are live references, not pinned evidence.
The catalogue includes relevant cross-cutting, service-specific and conditional repos; no repo is relevant to every function.
This initial map has not been evaluated with autonomous agents or customer research.
